question: Which investors had cash-flow activity during 2025 but purchased no holdings during 2025?

            FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
            WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 c
                WHERE c.investor_id = p.investor_id
                  AND c.date >= '2025-01-01' AND c.date < '2026-01-01'
            )
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001 o
                WHERE o.investor_id = p.investor_id
                  AND o.purchase_date >= '2025-01-01'
                  AND o.purchase_date < '2026-01-01'
            );

question: Which investors have at least three underfunded investment goals?
sql_query:

                   COUNT(*) AS underfunded_goal_count
            FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
            JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 g ON g.investor_id = p.investor_id
            WHERE g.shortfall > 0
            GROUP BY p.investor_id, p.investor_name
            HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3;

            SELECT DISTINCT investor_id, category
            FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
            WHERE category IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(category) <> ''
        )
        SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name, p.category AS profile_category
        FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
        LEFT JOIN investor_categories c
          ON c.investor_id = p.investor_id
         AND c.category = p.category
        WHERE p.category IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.category) <> ''
          AND c.investor_id IS NULL;
